description: Drafts schema markup (schema.org JSON-LD structured data) for a page: Organization, WebSite, FAQPage (questions read from headings that end in a question mark, with the text under them) or LocalBusiness. Values the person gives win over values read from the page. Use it when seo_audit_page reports missing or incomplete structured data. result has jsonLd, scriptTag (ready to paste into the <head>), filledFrom (each field: input or page), missing (fields to fill in) and existingTypes (schema types the page already declares). Returns JSON: summary (one sentence) and result (the details below); resultId and reportUrl are null, as drafts are not saved. Errors come back as one plain sentence. Recorded: the checked domain and path (never the query string), the tool, which checks failed and the app name; never an IP address or page text.

address.description: LocalBusiness only: the street address on one line.

logoUrl.description: An absolute logo image URL. Defaults to the page icon.

name.description: The organization or site name. Defaults to the page's.

phone.description: LocalBusiness only: the phone. Defaults to the page's first tel: link.

sameAs.description: Official profile URLs (LinkedIn, X, YouTube). Defaults to the social links on the page.

url.description: The page the markup describes: an absolute http or https URL, such as https://example.com/pricing.

name: draft_schema_markup
title: Draft schema markup (JSON-LD)
